pages.description: Experience bliss at Pullman Bali Legian Beach, one of Bali's best business and leisure resort, offering a serene beachfront retreat nestled between Kuta and Legian
pages.text:
Pullman Bali Legian Beach: Exquisite Bali Beachfront Hotel
Pullman Bali Legian Beach - Luxury hotel
WELCOME TO THE BEACH PARADISE FOR THRILL-SEEKERS
The perfect blend of sun-kissed relaxation and contemporary elegance tucked in the bustling Kuta and Legian area, the resort embodies a laid-back sophistication that promises an unforgettable escape.
Experience the magic of a clover-shaped beachfront oasis, where modern design meets the serenity of nature. Among the 378 rooms, some boast mesmerizing ocean views, allowing you to wake up to the soothing sounds of waves and the warm embrace of the morning sun. For a delectable culinary journey, look no further than the Montage, All-Day Dining. Here, culinary boundaries no longer exist, and each dish tells a captivating story. Sip on creatively crafted cocktails at the L-Bar, Garden Bar, or indulge in relaxation at the Infinity Pool (IP) Bar, where time slows down, and indulgence becomes an art form.
Planning a business meeting or a special event? Pullman Bali Legian Beach has extensive function rooms as the perfect canvas to bring your ideas to life, with the sea breeze and picturesque surroundings adding an inspiring touch.
When it s time to unwind, immerse yourself in the world of Tjakra7 Spa. This sanctuary harmonizes ancient healing rituals with modern wellness techniques, offering a spectrum of treatments designed to rejuvenate your spirit and leave you in a state of pure serenity.
So, pack your curiosity, bring your appetite for adventure, and allow Pullman Bali Legian Beach to create unforgettable memories during your stay.
Remember, every moment is an opportunity to celebrate the vibrant tapestry of life.

Get ready to indulge in the luxury of choice with our 378 vibrant rooms and suites sprawled across five floors, each one a unique slice of paradise. Elevate your stay with private balconies, sumptuous bathtubs, and expansive rain showers, ensuring your utmost privacy and relaxation. Superior Suite
Superior Suite
Welcome to the Superior Suite at Pullman Bali Legian Beach!
Immerse yourself in the comfort of your spacious 85 sqm retreat, designed to blend elegance with relaxation, creating an atmosphere of pure indulgence.
Step out onto your private balcony and immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of colors adorning our meticulously curated gardens. Let the vibrant hues of tropical blooms and swaying palms envelop you in a picturesque embrace, offering a serene escape and personal oasis amidst the captivating allure of Bali.
Unwind in your private living room, savoring a freshly brewed cup of coffee from your own Espresso Machine to energize your upcoming adventures. Stay seamlessly connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and a lively 55-inch Smart LED TV, ensuring you re always in the loop while reveling in the tranquility of your lavish suite.
Rest easy with the Safe Deposit Box securing your belongings, allowing you to explore Bali with peace of mind. Our trusty fridge is at your service, keeping your snacks cool and your energy high for the captivating experiences that await you on this vibrant island.
Welcome to your ultimate retreat at Pullman Bali Legian Beach!
Room Features
To keep you connected
• Complimentary Wi-Fi
For your comfort
• 32-inch Smart LED TV
• Espresso machine
• Private balcony
• Fridge
For your safety
• Safe Deposit Box
• Sprinkler in room
• Deadbolts and/or locks in the rooms
• Emergency info in rooms
• Keycard-operated door locks
• Security peephole
• Audible smoke alarms in rooms
